### Props

| Name        | Type      | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                            |
| ----------- | --------- | -------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `lines`     | `array`   |          | `[]`    | The lines: `{ key, level, at, message }`, `level` one of `success`, `warning`, `error`, `info`.                                        |
| `emptyText` | `string`  |          | `''`    | Shown when there are no lines.                                                                                                         |
| `withDay`   | `boolean` |          | `false` | Show the day before the time ("today 08:41"), for lines that span several runs. A single run's lines show the time to the millisecond. |
